scenario: [LGRA.5.8.6]: a `Json` value one node past the limit, 257, asserted by the host into a `Json` slot, is refused with `DS_ERR_JSON_LIMIT` (-221). Nothing changes, and NO fault event reaches the stream: the status is the whole host refusal, so `no_fault_events` fails a runtime that records a BoundsError. The value is LGRA.5.8.6_host_nodes_at_limit's 256 nodes (one array of fifteen arrays of sixteen Ints) with one more Int in the root. PATH PINNED: on libds, `ds_json_array_append` refuses the 257th value as pyds's `pyds_py_to_json_tree_at` builds the tree, so the engine is never called; on the Mercury runtime, `ds.engine.host_assert` refuses through `ds.fact`'s `sr_json_limit` and writes no effect. Every libds refusal of one names `DS_JSON_MAX_`.
